scripts.trigger-daily-fetch: npx tsc && node -e "const init = require('./dist/src/scripts/initializeIntelligentSystem').default; const cron = require('./dist/src/services/cronScheduler').default; (async () => { await init.initialize({connectMongoDB: true, initializeData: false, startScheduler: false, enableDailyCron: false}); const scheduler = cron.getInstance(); await scheduler.triggerImmediateDailyFetch(); process.exit(0); })()"
scripts.production-start: npx tsc && node -e "const ProductionScheduler = require('./dist/src/services/productionScheduler').default; (async () => { const scheduler = ProductionScheduler.getInstance(); await scheduler.startProductionScheduling(); })()"
scripts.production-score: npx tsc && node -e "const StockScoringService = require('./dist/src/services/stockScoringService').default; (async () => { await StockScoringService.calculateAllStockScores(); process.exit(0); })()"
scripts.production-recommend: npx tsc && node -e "const RecommendationEngine = require('./dist/src/services/recommendationEngine').default; (async () => { const result = await RecommendationEngine.generateStandardRecommendations(10000); console.log(JSON.stringify(result.allocations, null, 2)); process.exit(0); })()"
scripts.production-fetch-prices: npx tsc && node -e "const ProductionDataFetcher = require('./dist/src/services/productionDataFetcher').default; (async () => { await ProductionDataFetcher.fetchAllStockPrices(); process.exit(0); })()"
scripts.production-fetch-fundamentals: npx tsc && node -e "const ProductionDataFetcher = require('./dist/src/services/productionDataFetcher').default; (async () => { await ProductionDataFetcher.fetchAllStockFundamentals(); process.exit(0); })()"
